description:
Blood and Water is a gritty character driven crime-drama. The series follows Jo Bradley, the lead detective of the Vancouver homicide division, as she unravels a murder mystery steeped in scandal. Starring Simu Liu.

Huzzah worked on a number of shots for the series which included paint outs, fixing mistakes, screen replacement and so on.
